description: nx-mcp-plan-runner plan schema for the unified nx-agent. Two tiers: frozen planner output and executable format.

operation_fields.name: tool
operation_fields.values: one of the 32 certified NX_MCP tools

operation_fields.name: tool_args
operation_fields.note: real params sent to NX_MCP; logical names may appear as values

operation_fields.name: selection_criteria
operation_fields.note: local filter rules; NEVER sent to NX_MCP

operation_fields.name: expectation
operation_fields.note: judgement rules; NEVER sent to NX_MCP

operation_fields.name: refresh_edges_after
operation_fields.note: information only: previously cached edge indices are stale; the Runner never auto-lists

operation_fields.name: refresh_faces_after
operation_fields.note: information only: previously cached face indices are stale; the Runner never auto-lists

executable_extensions.note: A backward-compatible superset of the frozen format. The Runner binds results / selections / references ONLY through these explicit, machine-readable fields.

operation_extensions.name: result_bindings
operation_extensions.semantics: After a successful call, bind named response fields into the symbol table. Field keys are adapted-response fields: object / body / sketch / feature / part / path / objects. Values are logical names, or arrays of names (multi-name binding = aliases to the same result, e.g. an unite that re-bases the main solid). Objects use their .id.

operation_extensions.name: selection_binding
operation_extensions.semantics: On list steps (nx_list_edges / nx_list_faces) with selection_criteria: bind the locally-filtered result to the selection symbol. Flat criteria -> list of item indices. Named-group criteria -> {group_name: [indices]}. Consumers reference it as $selection.<name> or $selection.<name>.<group>. The build pass names bindings generically (sel_<step>); planner-authored plans may choose semantic names.

operation_extensions.name: retry
operation_extensions.semantics: The ONLY retries the Runner performs. Declared in the plan (from planner fallbacks or known loader transients); never invented at runtime. Retried only when the error text contains any substring of if_error_contains and retry count < max.

topology_safety.semantics: Any operation with topology_changes=true that completes successfully immediately invalidates the Runner's edge/face caches (and sets edges_valid/faces_valid=false). The Runner NEVER auto-lists after invalidation: only a later plan step that explicitly calls nx_list_edges / nx_list_faces re-populates the caches. Selection symbols are plan artifacts; plans must rebind them after topology changes.

reference_syntax.semantics: tool_args values may reference the symbol table. $name resolves the names table (logical -> real NX id). $selection.name resolves a flat selection (list of indices); $selection.name.group resolves a named group. Bare logical names (frozen format) also resolve when present in the symbol table. A single-element selection list used where a scalar is expected (e.g. remove_face_index) unwraps to the element. Natural-language placeholders (e.g. "<step49 匹配的 4 个 index>") are NOT part of the executable format.

selection_criteria_grammar.note: selection_criteria filter the tool result LOCALLY. Keys describe geometry; values are exact numbers, numeric ranges, candidate lists, or nested groups. Unknown/informational keys never fail.
edge_keys: curve_type (string or list of allowed types, e.g. ["Circular","Elliptical"])
bbox ([minX,minY,minZ] .. [maxX,maxY,maxZ] form: bbox as full extent array)
bbox_x / bbox_y / bbox_z (numeric range: containment — both the min and the max of the edge's bbox axis must lie within the range; prefer corners_xy for exact corner edges)
corners_xy (list of [x,y] candidates: edge bbox is degenerate at the corner; exact precision form for corner picking)
face_keys: normal ([x,y,z]; planar faces only — non-planar faces fail this criterion)
value_forms: number: exact match within tolerance (per-key tol override: {"value": n, "tol": t}; global default tol = 0.5)
array of candidates: match if the field is in the array (list-any)
{"any": [candidates...]}: match any candidate (used for e.g. multi-corner lists)
selection_criteria_grammar.group_mode: if every value of selection_criteria is itself an object of criteria keys, the criteria are NAMED GROUPS: each group filters independently and its match count is bound by name (e.g. {"flange_top": {...}, "boss_tops": {...}}).
informational_keys: keys ending in '_approx' are ACTIVE filters on the base key (strip '_approx', e.g. centroid_radius_approx -> centroid_radius)

expectation_grammar.x_min / x_max / y_min / y_max / z_min /: extents of matched items (Linear edge bbox for edges; centroid for faces); tolerance via tolerance_mm or default 0.5
expectation_grammar.done: edge_blend / chamfer done count (parsed from the raw loader result)
expectation_grammar.informational: keys named *_approx / *_auxiliary / area_auxiliary / purpose / note are logged, never failed

certified_tool_params.note: Allowed tool_args keys per certified tool (NX_MCP-Enhanced v2.1.1). The Runner validates resolved args against these before dispatch.

nx_sketch_rectangle.note: corner1/corner2 are the BRIDGE slot names; the runner adapter packs center into corner1 and width/height into corner2 (loader grammar cx cy w h)
